summary: Iteration 10 tested the MT5 live panel (GET /api/live/mt/positions and /mt-panel), the Tools 'Painel MT5' card, the bot-be break-even switch with PUT /api/bot breakeven_enabled, and check_exits with PTP and BE turned on or off. Backend: 5/5 API tests and 4/4 check_exits unit tests pass. Unit test results: with ptp_enabled and breakeven_enabled both false, the position is left alone at +1.1R and the stop still hits. With only BE on, only the stop moves to entry. Frontend: all requested flows work. /tools -> Painel MT5 -> /mt-panel shows the real Vantage demo account (EUR 203.14, 1 ETHUSD position, -0.04 EUR). It refetches every 5 s (2 requests in 11 s, and the live price changed). The first tap on Close shows 'Confirmar'; I did NOT tap a second time. The back button returns to /tools. The bot-be switch turns BE off, 'Guardar Configuração' saves it, and it is still off after reload. I then restored it to true. user_test1 stayed on live_mode=paper, and no MT orders were placed or closed. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: With breakeven_enabled=false and ptp_enabled=true, the partial TP still moves the stop to entry (sets stop_loss=entry and be=True). The unit test confirms this. For MT positions, _live_sell also sends POSITION_MODIFY to break-even. The BE switch therefore does not fully disable break-even while PTP is on. This may be intended (the bot-ptp text says so), but it conflicts with a user who wants 'sem break even'.
The standalone break-even step only updates the DB/simulated stop. It does not send POSITION_MODIFY to MetaTrader, so the broker SL in the MT app never moves to BE.

The MT stop is widened by the spread, but the simulated position keeps the original narrower stop_loss/take_profit and entry. pos is not updated, unlike the Binance path. check_exits uses the data-feed quote, so it closes the MT position (POSITION_CLOSE_ID) when the narrower simulated stop is hit. The spread-widened MT stop is effectively bypassed, and TP closes happen at the paper level, not the MT level.

The panel can close any MT position, including bot-managed ones, but the matching db.positions entry stays open. Later, check_exits sends a close that fails (only logged) and books paper PnL that differs from MT. The bot position should be marked as closed when it is closed from the panel.
bot = comment.startswith('S') also tags manual test orders ('ST teste') and any comment starting with 'S' as 'Robô SmartTrade'. Matching 'SmartTrade' exactly would be safer.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Confirmar' state never resets. It survives refetches (still 'Confirmar' 6 s later), so a later stray tap closes a real position. Add a timeout of about 3-5 s or reset it on blur.

issues: The Close button is 88x36, below the 44pt touch-target minimum (minHeight 36).
Margin level shows '507750%' when margin is tiny; consider capping the display or showing '—' above a threshold.
The bot-be switch saves only after 'Guardar Configuração', and there is no unsaved-changes hint. The 12C/20 switches above auto-save, which is inconsistent.
The bot-ptp description says it moves the stop to break-even even when the Break-even switch is off, which is confusing.

action_items: Decide whether PTP should move the stop to BE when breakeven_enabled=false. If not, gate the 'stop_loss: entry, be: True' in the PTP branch, and the MT POSITION_MODIFY in _live_sell, on be_on.
Send POSITION_MODIFY to MT in the standalone BE step for live MT positions.

In _go_mt, store the MT fill and the widened SL/TP on pos (entry/stop_loss/take_profit, or a live.sl/live.tp that check_exits respects), so the bot does not close the MT position at the narrower paper stop.
When /live/mt/test-close closes a position linked to a bot db position, mark that db position as closed.
Auto-reset the MT panel 'Confirmar' state after a few seconds, and raise closeBtn minHeight to 44.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2578 lines (well over 700); splitting the MT/live execution code into its own module is recommended.
_live_sell partial MT path: the BE stop uses p['entry'] (paper signal entry), not the MT open price, so it may be rejected by the broker or placed on the wrong side of the spread.
seed_data_creation: The unit test creates and deletes positions/bots/bot_logs/accounts for user_id TEST_check_exits_unit. No changes to user_test1 remain; breakeven_enabled was restored to true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/bot returns {bot:{...}}. The bot-be switch needs a normal click (not force) and then bot-save-button to persist. Run pytest with '-n 0' for the unit test, because pytest.ini adds xdist. Never tap mt-pos-close twice: it closes a real Vantage demo position.
